questions.location: Where exactly do you feel it?
questions.severity: How bad is it, from 0 to 10?
questions.timing: Is it constant, or does it come and go?
questions.associatedSymptoms: Have you noticed anything else along with it?
questions.redFlags: Has anything frightened you, like fainting, bleeding or the worst pain of your life?
questions.pastMedicalHistory: Do you have any medical conditions, or have you had operations before?
questions.allergies: Are you allergic to any medicines?
questions.familyHistory: Does anything run in your family?
questions.socialHistory: Tell me about your work, smoking, alcohol and recent travel.
questions.riskFactors: Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure or high cholesterol?
questions.ice: What do you think is going on, and what worries you most?

empty.title: Start the interview
empty.body: Introduce yourself and ask in your own words. Type / for orders, examination and chart sections.

composer.hint: Enter to send. Shift+Enter for a new line. / for commands.
composer.callOff: Start a voice call with the patient

offTopic.label: Off topic
offTopic.note: The patient answered in character, but the history did not move forward. Bring the conversation back to the presenting problem.

answerSeeking.label: Stays in role
answerSeeking.note: The patient cannot give you the diagnosis or the answer. Ask about symptoms, history or examination instead.

injection.label: Blocked
injection.note: This message was not sent to the patient: it tried to change the simulation's instructions.

unsafe.label: Support
unsafe.note: The simulation paused the role play. If this is about you, please reach out to someone you trust or local emergency services.
